boards.name: 맨손
boards.equipment: Both hands empty, relaxed alternating arm swing; herb bag strapped at left hip, strap across right shoulder.
boards.prompt: Create a TRUE TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND production-development SPRITE SHEET, no paper, NO text NO labels NO grid lines NO portraits NO scene NO shadows NO UI. Wide landscape 1536x1024 intended proportions. EXACTLY EIGHT equal-width columns and FOUR equal-height rows, 32 isolated full-body PIXEL ART sprites TOTAL. Each cell has equal generous transparent padding. Body silhouette about 48x64 source-pixel proportions enlarged uniformly, character feet aligned to same local ground line at 85 percent cell height; all standing heads same height, consistent exact body scale, no random resizing. Pixel-art ONLY crisp square pixels. Match reference AEL's exact youthful brown tousled hair, green eyes, simple dark forest-green cloak, ivory lace-up tunic, brown gloves dark brown trousers brown boots leather herb satchel. Avoid anime painted sprites. Each ROW is one fixed facing direction: ROW1 FRONT toward viewer (screen down), ROW2 BACK away (screen up), ROW3 LEFT profile facing screen left, ROW4 RIGHT profile facing screen right. NEVER mix directions within a row. Each row EXACT same EIGHT columns ordered: 1 neutral idle standing feet together; 2 walk left-foot contact; 3 walk left-foot weight-down; 4 walk right-leg passing; 5 walk right-foot contact; 6 walk right-foot weight-down; 7 walk left-leg passing; 8 stop settled stance feet planted. Walk columns2-7 form a cyclic six-frame step: truly different opposing leg/foot positions with alternating feet and natural small cloak follow-through, NO arbitrary whole-body vertical bouncing or moving across cell. Maintain torso location; only leg articulation and small arms/cloak changes. Back walking must visibly change feet below cloak, shorten/lift cloak hem just enough for foot visibility. Equipment: Both hands empty, relaxed alternating arm swing; herb bag strapped at left hip, strap across right shoulder.. Anatomical RIGHT and LEFT stay consistent across directions, no naive mirroring asymmetric bag or weapons. Every entire weapon, hair and cloak inside own cell, no overlapping cells. No extra sprites anywhere, no cropping, only32 sprites. This is an animation development atlas to be reviewed, not a portrait reference board.
review_notes: 발 원점·몸 크기·픽셀 밀도·걷기 위상 정합화 필요
